messages:
Maya K: Heads up — noticed ~120 invoices in NetSuite with a duplicated credit line this morning after the nightly billing run. Looks like credit memos for subscription downgrades were split into two lines instead of one, causing amounts to be applied twice. This only affects invoices created between 02:15-02:40 UTC.

Ryan H: ugh. did we replay webhooks last night?

Maya K: I didn't see a manual replay but the webhook-processor DLQ had a small redrive around 02:20 from the ops team (ticket CS-4211). Could be related.

Ashwin: quick note — our webhook consumer uses Stripe's idempotency_key + message.id to dedupe, but the redrive path reconstructs events and we lost the original idempotency header. That would explain duplicates.

Billing Bot: [alert] invoice-sync-job #billing-nightly-v3 FAILED (exit 1) at 2026-03-16T02:41:12Z. See /logs/billing/2026-03-16/02 for details.

Maya K: Copying logs below. The NetSuite API call shows two createCreditMemo calls for the same stripe_charge_id:

```
2026-03-16T02:28:03Z INFO billing-worker createCreditMemo request body {"customer":"cust_123", "amount": -50, "metadata":{"stripe_charge":"ch_1A2B3C"}}
2026-03-16T02:28:04Z INFO billing-worker createCreditMemo response 200 ns=320ms id=ns_987
2026-03-16T02:28:30Z INFO billing-worker createCreditMemo request body {"customer":"cust_123", "amount": -50, "metadata":{"stripe_charge":"ch_1A2B3C"}}
2026-03-16T02:28:31Z INFO billing-worker createCreditMemo response 200 ns=310ms id=ns_988
```

Maya K: So NetSuite got two credit memos. One of them was netted against the invoice and created a duplicate negative line.

Ryan H: Thanks. Can you open a quick DB query to confirm whether the billing_events table has two entries for the same stripe_event_id? If yes we need to either rollback the extra credit memos or mark one as stale in NetSuite (and update the ledger).

Maya K: Running query now:

```
SELECT count(*) FROM billing_events WHERE stripe_event_id = 'evt_rdr_999' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-16 02:10' AND '2026-03-16 02:50';
-- returns 2
```

Ashwin: yep that's the problem. billing-events has 2 rows. The first has idempotency_key "stripe_evt_abc" but the redriven one has idempotency_key null. Because the redrive path didn't copy headers.

Ryan H: Short-term mitigation: disable the nightly redrive for DLQ messages until we patch the replay logic to retain idempotency headers. I'll put a pause on CS-4211 requeue.

Ops SRE: paused redrive at 02:55 UTC. Also added a guard on the requeue tool to require the original headers.

Maya K: For remediation we need to: 1) identify all affected invoices (02:15-02:40 window + duplicated stripe_charge ids) 2) decide whether to void duplicate credit memo in NetSuite or create a reversal journal 3) update ledger to remove double credit so revenue is correct. I started a Google Sheet: https://go/gdoc/credit-duplicates-2026-03-16 (internal)

Ashwin: I can prepare a script to reconcile net amounts and emit a NetSuite void request for credit memos with pattern ns_988 (where duplicate exists). But need signoff from Finance.

Maya K: tagging @Ryan H and @Ops SRE for signoff. Also need to notify Customer Success for any customers with balance changes >$100.

Ryan H: signoff for script to void duplicate credit memos. Please add guard to only void memos where the original memo exists and total invoice debit/credit would be restored to the pre-run amount. Also include a dry-run mode output.

Maya K: Will do. Ashwin, please include a CSV with ns ids + customer + invoice_num + duplicate_memo_id + amount. Then Finance (me) will approve the list.

Ashwin: putting together CSV now — will push to the sheet and create a PR with the script in infra-scripts. Dry-run output expected in ~20m.

Billing Bot: [info] reconciliation-helper: dry-run produced 118 candidate voids, total amount $3,420. Details in /artifacts/2026-03-16/void-dryrun-2165432109.csv

Maya K: OK. I'll review the CSV and start notifying CS for >$100 cases. Please don't run the voids until I ack.

Ryan H: after this patch we should update the redrive path to reattach stripe idempotency headers and add an integration test for it. I filed GH issue infra#5423.

Ashwin: noted — will include tests. Also adding a small backfill job to detect null idempotency_key records in billing_events and mark them for manual review going forward.

Maya K: Thanks team. Post-incident: add a note to the runbook 'billing/nightly-redrive' about preserving headers and how to triage duplicates.

Ops SRE: Noted. Closing the immediate alert, continuing with postmortem actions. :white_check_mark:
